mission.label: MISIÓN FINAL · NIVEL A1
mission.title: Un día con amigos
mission.briefing: Acompaña a Ana al parque. Primero, revisa el tiempo y prepara sus pertenencias. Después, confirma el autobús y los horarios, pide que repitan las indicaciones y reúnete con sus amigos. Termina respondiendo en voz alta.
objectives: Prepara lo necesario para la salida
Aclara la información y llega al parque
Responde cuatro veces en voz alta
mission.completion_message: Llegaste al parque, resolviste situaciones cotidianas y respondiste en inglés.

chapters.title: Prepara la salida
chapters.objective: Pregunta por el tiempo y encuentra lo que necesitas.

chapters.title: Viaja y confirma
chapters.objective: Consigue el boleto, confirma los horarios y viaja al parque.

chapters.title: Encuentra el camino
chapters.objective: Pide indicaciones claras y llega al parque.

chapters.title: Un día con amigos
chapters.objective: Pide agua y acuerda actividades con tus amigos.

lesson.goal: Prepare, travel, solve a misunderstanding and join friends at the park.
lesson.grammar_function: Apply previously taught A1 language throughout a coherent outing.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Prepare for an outing, clarify travel information, request what you need, respond to invitations and speak in four everyday encounters.

source_beats.title: Check today’s weather
source_beats.scene: Before choosing what to take, Ana asks Luis about today’s weather at home. His answer establishes the cold, rainy outing; both speakers have distinct views.

source_beats.title: Prepare for the weather
source_beats.scene: Ana prepares for the same cold, rainy trip. Four distinct targets show the speaker indicating her cold fingers, her pair of gloves, her winter coat and her boots. Later views retain these belongings.

source_beats.title: Leave with what you need
source_beats.scene: Four connected moments follow Ana, wearing the same clothes and carrying the same umbrella and bag, from home to the stop.

cues.en: I have my boots and my umbrella.
I am going to the park.
First, I walk to the bus stop.
Then, I am at the bus stop.
cues.target: Visible arrival at the same stop

source_beats.title: Find the right bus
source_beats.scene: Ana asks a helper at the stop. Exactly two visible speaking roles; the response identifies the bus.

cues.en: Which bus goes to the park?
The blue bus goes to the park.

source_beats.title: Ask again
source_beats.scene: Ana did not understand; the same helper repeats the same destination and bus.

cues.en: I do not understand. Please repeat.
The blue bus goes to the park.

source_beats.title: Get the ticket
source_beats.scene: At the counter, Ana requests a ticket; the agent hands it over. Ticket ownership changes visibly.

cues.en: Can I have a ticket, please?

source_beats.title: Check departure
source_beats.scene: Ana asks departure time; the agent indicates a clock/timetable showing nine.

cues.en: What time does the bus leave?

source_beats.title: Check arrival
source_beats.scene: Same service, a different arrival field/time; leave and arrive are never swapped.

cues.en: What time does the bus arrive?

source_beats.title: Ride to the park stop
source_beats.scene: Four consecutive travel moments keep the same Ana, bus, ticket and destination. The bus arrives before she gets off.

cues.en: First, I get on the blue bus.
Then, I get off the bus.

source_beats.title: Clarify and follow the route
source_beats.scene: Visible Spanish setup establishes that Ana could not follow the directions. Two speaking roles at the stop: Ana requests slower speech and the helper gives the route clearly. A non-assessed scene transition then shows Ana walking straight, turning left and reaching the park with the same belongings.

cues.en: You speak fast. Please speak slowly.

cues.target: Helper repeats the previously established route clearly

source_beats.title: Meet everyday needs
source_beats.scene: At the park café, needs cause a request, handover and thanks. Four linked scene moments keep the customer, server and drink consistent.

cues.en: I am thirsty. I need water.

source_beats.title: Invite a friend
source_beats.scene: At the park, Sofía invites Luis. His visible tired state is context; the heard refusal establishes the actual reply.

cues.en: Do you want to play football?

source_beats.title: Offer an alternative
source_beats.scene: Same people and time. Music is a suitable alternative to active play.

cues.en: Do you want to listen to music?

source_beats.title: Include another friend
source_beats.scene: Ana shares her interest in photography at the park; her friend proposes doing it together. The next scene visibly shows them taking photos before the later meeting is agreed.

source_beats.title: Agree on the next meeting
source_beats.scene: After the activity, the friends agree on a later day. They remain together at the park.

cues.target: Sofía suggests a future activity through the taught invitation chunk

source_voice.question: How are you?
source_voice.answer: I am happy. I am at the park.
source_voice.purpose: Tell the friend how you feel now that the trip succeeded.

source_voice.question: Where is the bathroom?
source_voice.purpose: Help a friend, using the established park layout.

source_voice.question: Do you want to play football?
source_voice.purpose: Give a polite refusal in a separate, clearly established encounter.

source_voice.question: Do you want to listen to music?
source_voice.answer: Yes, thank you. Let's listen to music.
source_voice.purpose: Agree on the shared activity; the final scene shows the friends together.
